correctness.rationale: PASS: Stewart's odd divisor-gap criterion and its prime-multiplication closure (precisely restated in Jokar Proposition 3.6 and Proposition 3.10) reduce three-support odd almost practical numbers to 3^a5^b7^c. If a=1, divisor jump 7 to 15 fails at partial sum 16; n=315=(2,1,1) fails last transition 315>307. Direct ordered-divisor gap checks establish bases 945=(3,1,1), 1575=(2,2,1), 2205=(2,1,2), and closure yields all a>=2 with a+b+c>=5. Independent reconstruction checked every 216 exponent triples 1<=a,b,c<=6 and three base sums, corroboration only.
